Bill.BriefDescription: Creating a citizen's committee to monitor noise abatement at Sea-Tac airport.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to the creation of a citizen's committee to monitoraircraft noise abatement programs administered by the Port of Seattleat SeattleTacoma International Airport; and adding a new section tochapter 53.54 RCW.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 53.54 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: (1) The citizen's committee on aircraft noise abatement isestablished to advise the Port of Seattle, as well as appropriatestate, local, and federal agencies, regarding the operation of aircraftnoise abatement programs authorized under this chapter regarding theSeattleTacoma International Airport. The committee shall serve as anadvisory committee to the Port of Seattle on matters relating to thepolicies, administration, procedures, and funding of aircraft noiseabatement programs. The port shall consult with and provide periodicreports to the committee on matters related to the port's aircraftnoise abatement program, including but not limited to program policies,procedures, administration, and funding. p. 1 HB 1930 (2) The committee shall have a total of eleven members who eitherreside in areas impacted by the noise from SeattleTacoma InternationalAirport or who represent governmental entities having jurisdictionwithin the impacted areas. The appointments shall be made by thegovernor and the appointees shall serve staggered threeyear terms.The committee membership shall consist of: (a) Three membersconsisting of officials from three cities within the impacted areas;(b) one King county official; and (c) seven citizen members who residein the impacted areas. All members of the committee may participatefully in the committee's meetings and activities and shall timelyreceive all notices and information related to committee business anddecisions. (3) The port shall seek recommendations and comments from thecommittee regarding the port's aircraft noise abatement program. Theport shall also provide the committee with sixty days' advance noticeof any proposed changes in the policies, procedures, or administrationof its aircraft noise abatement program, and shall consider therecommendations and comments of the committee with respect to suchproposed changes. In the event the port does not follow therecommendations of the committee, the port shall provide the committeewith a written explanation stating the reasoning behind, and thefactual basis for, the decision to not follow such recommendations. (4) At the request of the committee, the governing body of the portshall meet with the committee not less than three times per calendaryear, at intervals to be determined by the committee. (5) The port shall fully and timely respond to requests forinformation that are submitted by the committee. (6) Under this section, "impacted areas" has the same meaning asdefined under RCW 53.54.020. (7) The committee established in this section constitutes a classone group under RCW 43.03.220. Expenses for this group, includingstaff support, shall be provided by the department of community, trade,and economic development.
